about_the_game:
Do you love the thrill? The so-called adrenaline Kick?

Then this game is perfect for you. You’ll need to make split-second decisions at over 250 km/h, weaving through rush-hour traffic on the highway. If you make the wrong choice, even your guardian angel will say goodbye.

This game is inspired by the legendary Ghost Rider, who has kept police forces on international roads on their toes. We’ve tried to capture the atmosphere of his videos so you can relive those experiences in your own way.

As developers and publishers, however, we strongly advise against imitating such behavior in real life. Never forget—you only have one life.

At the beginning, you will drive on endless tracks, with time and distance being measured. You can view your results in a local leaderboard.

During Early Access, a competitive track is planned to be added, where, like Ghost Rider, you must get from point A to point B as quickly as possible. This will also include an online leaderboard. However, this track is still under development.

However, reckless driving won’t get you anywhere. Here, it’s all about driving with foresight and steering at the right moment. Controlling a motorcycle at over 250 km/h is a high art—it takes a calm demeanor and nerves of steel.

May you all reach the finish line safely and engage in some close races for the best times.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5700x or comparable
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX3090
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OnBoard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 7950 or comparable
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX4070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OnBoard

short_description: Feel like Ghost Rider and race across the highways and streets of Germany. A race in the grey area of the law, because there is no speed limit for you. But always remember, every decision could be your last. You don't have unlimited guardian angels.
